title: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Tanker Report - November 17, 2026
summary:
Main
• Sentiment-Driven Correction Meets Improving Vessel Supply - Crude tanker freight has corrected sharply from October's unprecedented highs , initially driven by changing geopolitical sentiment following the US midterm elections. Expectations of de-escalation weakened freight sentiment, although the subsequent decline has increasingly been supported by changes in physical market conditions. Improving crude availability and rising inventories have reduced refiners' urgency to secure cargoes, while the resumption of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline operations has allowed tanker positioning to adjust to more established trading patterns.
